nodes.description: Public total token supply inherited from ERC20Basic; mutated in constructor, burn and mint.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances held in BasicToken.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) of ERC20 allowances in StandardToken.
Owner address state variable of Ownable; controls privileged functions.
Boolean flag in MintableToken that permanently disables minting when true.
Human readable token name set in the VCTToken constructor.
Token symbol set in the VCTToken constructor.
Token decimals (18) used as exponent when computing the initial supply.
BasicToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after balance and overflow checks.
BasicToken.balanceOf: view that returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves tokens using caller allowance from _from to _to.
StandardToken.approve: overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _amount.
StandardToken.allowance: view returning remaining allowance of _spender for _owner.
BurnableToken.burn: destroys _value tokens of msg.sender and reduces totalSupply.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner address.
MintableToken.mint: onlyOwner/canMint function that inflates totalSupply and credits _to.
MintableToken.finishMinting: onlyOwner/canMint function that sets mintingFinished to true.
VCTToken.multiSend: loops over dests/values arrays calling transfer for each pair.
VCTToken constructor: mints initialSupply * 10**decimals to msg.sender and sets name/symbol.
VCTToken payable fallback that unconditionally reverts any sent ether.
VCTToken.getTokenDetail: view returning name, symbol and totalSupply.
SafeMath.add: overflowing addition guarded by assert(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction guarded by assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication guarded by assert(c / a == b).
Caller-controlled address used as balance holder, spender, minter and owner.
Unchecked raw multiplication initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) in the VCTToken constructor.
Unbounded while loop over the caller-supplied dests array in multiSend (gas exhaustion / DoS).
approve overwrites the allowance without zeroing it first, enabling allowance front-running.
Parameter _to of BasicToken.transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter _amount of BasicToken.transfer, the transferred value.
Parameter _owner of BasicToken.balanceOf, the queried address.
Parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom, the debited address.
Parameter _to of StandardToken.transferFrom, the credited address.
Parameter _amount of StandardToken.transferFrom, the transferred value.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve, the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _amount of StandardToken.approve, the new allowance value.
Parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance, the token owner.
Parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance, the spender being queried.
Parameter _value of BurnableToken.burn, the amount to destroy.
Parameter newOwner of Ownable.transferOwnership, the incoming owner address.
Parameter _to of MintableToken.mint, the mint recipient.
Parameter _amount of MintableToken.mint, the amount minted.
Parameter dests of VCTToken.multiSend, the recipient array.
Parameter values of VCTToken.multiSend, the amount array.
Loop counter i initialised to 0 in VCTToken.multiSend.
Parameter initialSupply of the VCTToken constructor, the mint base amount.
Parameter tokenName of the VCTToken constructor.
Parameter tokenSymbol of the VCTToken constructor.

edges.reason: transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
transfer indexes the balances mapping with the caller-supplied msg.sender.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub to deduct the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transferFrom updates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in the allowance lookup.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance deduction.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve overwrites an existing allowance without clearing it first.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
burn reduces balances[msg.sender].
burn reduces totalSupply using SafeMath.sub to prevent underflow.
burn reads msg.sender to determine whose balance is destroyed.
burn calls SafeMath.sub for both balance and supply reduction.
transferOwnership mutates the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before allowing the transfer.
mint increases totalSupply via SafeMath.add to avoid overflow.
mint credits the recipient entry in the balances mapping.
canMint modifier gates mint on the mintingFinished flag.
onlyOwner modifier restricts mint to the owner address.
mint calls SafeMath.add for supply and balance inflation.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true, stopping further minting.
onlyOwner modifier on finishMinting.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
constructor assigns totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals).
constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole total supply.
constructor uses msg.sender as the initial token holder.
constructor uses decimals as the exponent for the supply computation.
constructor writes the token name state variable.
constructor writes the token symbol state variable.
constructor performs a raw unchecked multiplication on the attacker-influenced initialSupply.
unchecked multiplication can wrap and corrupt the stored totalSupply.
multiSend repeatedly invokes transfer inside its while loop.
multiSend loops over an unbounded caller-supplied array without a length cap.
multiSend indirectly mutates balances through transfer.
transfer recipient parameter feeds the balances write.
transfer amount parameter feeds the balance arithmetic.
balanceOf owner parameter is the mapping lookup key.
transferFrom _from parameter selects the debited balance.
transferFrom _to parameter selects the credited balance.
transferFrom _amount parameter drives balance and allowance arithmetic.
approve _spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
approve _amount parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
allowance _owner parameter is the outer allowance mapping key.
allowance _spender parameter is the inner allowance mapping key.
burn _value parameter drives balance and supply reduction.
transferOwnership newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
mint _to parameter selects the credited balance.
mint _amount parameter drives the SafeMath.add operations.
multiSend dests parameter supplies the loop recipients.
multiSend values parameter supplies the loop amounts.
multiSend local counter i controls the while loop iterations.
constructor initialSupply parameter feeds the unchecked supply multiplication.
constructor tokenName parameter is stored in the name state variable.
constructor tokenSymbol parameter is stored in the symbol state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to feed transfer's balances write, so it can be inlined into the transfer node.
Amount parameter is only used by transfer's SafeMath arithmetic and can be folded into the transfer node.
Lookup key parameter has no independent behaviour and collapses into balanceOf.
_from only selects the debited balance and can be merged into transferFrom.
_to only selects the credited balance and can be merged into transferFrom.
_amount is consumed solely by transferFrom's balance and allowance math.
_spender is only an index into allowed and collapses into approve.
_amount is written directly by approve and can be folded into it.
_owner is purely a read key and merges into allowance.
_spender is purely a read key and merges into allowance.
_value drives burn's SafeMath.sub calls and can be inlined into burn.
newOwner is the sole input written to owner and merges into transferOwnership.
_to only selects the credited balance inside mint.
_amount is used only by mint's SafeMath.add operations.
dests only supplies the loop recipients used by multiSend.
values only supplies the loop amounts used by multiSend.
Local loop counter i has no meaning outside the multiSend while loop.
initialSupply is the attack surface of the unchecked multiplication and merges into that unsafe operation.
tokenName is only stored into name by the constructor.
tokenSymbol is only stored into symbol by the constructor.
